messages:
oncall-bot: Pager — outbound webhook spike detected from prod-webhook-forwarder to https://hooks.external-co/... (~50 reqs in 10m). Possible debug payloads containing S3 metadata. Escalating for immediate mitigation.

emily.dev: I'm seeing the same in the forwarder logs. sample payload (redacted):
```
{"user_id":"u-12345","email":"[redacted]","s3_key":"prod-logs/2026/03/17/debug-conn.log","debug":"stack trace + presigned fragment ..."}
```
Looks like S3 keys and partial presigned fragments were included in debug dumps. No object bodies transferred yet.

sachin: Any customer-facing errors? 5xxs or failed deliveries?

emily.dev: All webhooks returned 200s; external accepted posts. No downloads observed so far. However debug payload may contain customer identifiers — treat as potential exposure.

jordan-sre: Immediate actions: (1) block egress to hooks.external-co at edge LB/firewall, (2) rotate webhook signing secret, (3) start scan for leaked keys in S3 and logs. Can someone flip the egress ACL?

emily.dev: Blocking egress now: `egressctl block --service webhook-forwarder --host hooks.external-co` — command executed, outbound calls dropped :white_check_mark:

maria-secalert: Good. Rotate webhook signing secret and any service tokens that issue presigned URLs. Note: AWS presigned URLs can’t be revoked; we should rotate issuer IAM keys and shorten future expiry.

sachin: Rotating webhook secret into Vault and forcing rollout: `vault kv put secret/prod/webhook signing_key=@new_key` then `kubectl rollout restart deploy/webhook-forwarder` — restarted and new key applied.

emily.dev: Started a background job to scan for leaked key patterns across logs and S3: `python infra/scan/scan_for_presigned.py --hint 'prod-logs/*debug*'` — preliminary run found ~12 matches referencing debug keys. Kicking off a full scan.

legal: Please collect and preserve sample payloads in the secure evidence bucket with limited ACLs. Redact direct PII before sharing externally. Legal needs an incident brief and timeline to assess regulatory notification obligations.

ops-manager: Any confirmed customer impact? Which customers are tied to those S3 keys?

emily.dev: Early mapping ties a few keys to internal debug buckets that include customer IDs in path. No confirmed unauthorized downloads yet. Recommend pre-notice to customers with high-risk indicators and continuous monitoring of S3 access logs for the referenced keys.

jordan-sre: I'll open INC-2149007777 and document timeline, mitigations, and owners. Assigning overnight follow-up to @sachin. Next steps: finish S3 scan, rotate any IAM creds found in the scan, prepare customer notification drafts, and log all evidence.

sachin: Acknowledged. I'll take the oncall shift through 22:00 UTC and will update the incident with scan results and rotation status. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Pager cleared — handoff posted in #oncall-rotations. If outbound activity resumes, pager will reopen automatically.
